# Cartwheel refund policy

Approved refunds go back to the original payment method and arrive in 5 to 10 business days. Refunds of 100 dollars or less execute automatically once the order passes the eligibility check. Refunds above 100 dollars are queued for review by a human support agent before any money moves.

# Cartwheel order cancellation policy

An order can be cancelled at no cost any time before the store ships it. Once an order has shipped it can no longer be cancelled; the buyer should instead wait for delivery and request a return under the Cartwheel return policy.

title: Roles and permissions on Cartwheel
audience: all
status: dev-placeholder
---

# Roles and permissions on Cartwheel

Cartwheel has three roles. Shoppers can see and manage their own orders. Merchants can see and manage orders of their own store, and cannot see other stores' orders or shoppers' other purchases. Support staff can look up any order. The platform enforces these permissions in its systems; support assistants cannot grant exceptions.
